issues.detail: The Greek 'διὰ τί ἐπλήρωσεν ὁ σατανας τὴν καρδίαν σου' means 'how/why did Satan fill your heart', but the Vietnamese 'đầy lòng ngươi' (filled your heart) misses the causal/interrogative 'διὰ τί' (by what/how/why). More importantly, the Vietnamese 'bớt lại một phần vinh dự của ruộng' translates 'νοσφισασθαι ἀπὸ τῆς τιμῆς τοῦ χωρίου' as 'reducing a part of the honor of the field'. The Greek 'τιμῆς' in this context refers to the 'profit/proceeds/yield' of the land, not 'honor' (vinh dự). This changes the economic nature of the offense.
